summary: The PR addresses an issue with missing attributes in Poly3DCollection but introduces potential behavioral regressions and lacks documentation.

issues.description: Calling `do_3d_projection` inside `get_facecolor` and `get_edgecolor` could lead to unintended side effects, especially if these methods are called outside of a plotting context.
The added code does not include any additional documentation or comments explaining why `_facecolors2d` and `_edgecolors2d` are not initialized until `do_3d_projection`.
